correctness.rationale: The explicit local affine interpolation error admits a uniform second-order polynomial remainder expansion. Exact integration yields the conditional variance polynomial and its exact first and second shift moments. Conditional independent bounded residuals satisfy Lindeberg and yield the normal scale mixture with conditional variance the explicit random conditional variance. Fourth-moment convergence follows from fourth cumulant order inverse cell count. Unconditional covariance between strata is zero despite shared Xi, proving exact equal finite-m variances under common and independent shifts. The paired-residual estimator is exactly conditionally unbiased and consistent at the fifth-power sampling scale scale, yielding the Gaussian studentized pivot. The independent-shift scheme satisfies ordinary triangular-array Lindeberg. The packaged verify.py established 137 exact/symbolic and numerical checks, including the quadratic identity and limiting coverage integral. Bounds and proof are for every positive integer cell count and every nonaffine twice continuously differentiable integrand, not generalized by finite testing.

value.rationale: Kunsch’s actual implementation shares a global interpolation shift. Exact matching finite-sample variance of shared and independent phase estimators would obscure a real normal-calibration difference. The universal \(101/27\) kurtosis, explicit asymptotic naive-95%-coverage around \(0.9446368\), and consistent no-extra-function-evaluation paired-residual standard error make the distinction actionable for confidence intervals in high-order stratified quadrature. This is a natural algorithmic design comparison and an exact structural benchmark, not a routine renaming or arbitrary slice. Limits: one-dimensional C^2 and specific order-two interpolation; no finite-sample coverage or optimality claim.
